_comment: frontend/src/data/chatBotRepliesData.json — canned reply text for the 'Cuvva Support Bot' chat screen (ChatConversationPage.jsx). NO real AI/backend — per instruction, each of the 5 quick-reply buttons shown in chat3.jpeg has its own hand-written canned answer here. Any freely-typed message that doesn't match a quick-reply is met with one of the entries in 'fallbackReplies' (a random pick, per instruction: 'if the user ask any other question then just show a random answer only').

quickReplies.label: I have a question
quickReplies.reply: Sure, what would you like to know? You can also search our help centre above for a quick answer, or just type your question here and I'll do my best to help.

quickReplies.label: I would like to cancel my policy
quickReplies.reply: Sorry to hear you want to cancel. You can cancel a policy any time from the Policies tab in the app. If you're within the 14-day cooling-off period, cancellation is usually free — after that, a cancellation fee may apply depending on your policy type.

quickReplies.label: I want to delete my account
quickReplies.reply: You can request account deletion from Profile > Account details > Delete your account. If you have an active policy, you may need to wait until it ends before we can fully delete your account.

quickReplies.label: I need to make a claim
quickReplies.reply: Sorry to hear that. Please report the incident as soon as possible via the Claims section in the app, even if you're not sure you'll need to claim. Our claims team is on hand to help you through the process.

quickReplies.label: I have a financial, medical/mental health or language concern to talk about
quickReplies.reply: Thank you for letting us know — we take this seriously. A member of our human support team will follow up with you directly. In the meantime, if you need urgent help, please contact the relevant emergency or support services in your area.
